tool.name: generate-azure-change-digest
tool.description: Read-only daily digest of relevant Azure control-plane changes (Change Analysis in Azure Resource Graph, Reader): filters platform noise, scores deletes, exposure and security settings, SKU changes, new role assignments and Activity Log gap events (locks, diagnostic settings, policy, RBAC deletes), shows who / when / client and old -> new values, flags after-hours, first-time-actor and burst activity, and writes an offline HTML report, a JSON snapshot and two CSV files. Never changes anything.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: report (default: HTML + JSON + changes CSV + property diffs CSV) or query (bounded chat view, no files).

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Rolling window: last_24h (default), last_7d or last_14d (Change Analysis retention).

parameters.name: min_level
parameters.description: Lowest level listed in detail: high, medium (default) or low. Lower levels are still counted.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Only with operation=query: summary (default), relevant, deletes, security, actors, unusual, rbac, noise or coverage.

parameters.name: resource_group
parameters.description: Optional focus: resource group name or part of one (letters, digits, _ - . ( ), up to 90 characters). Empty = all.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Only with operation=query: maximum rows, 1-100 (default 25); answers are capped to 3,500 bytes.

skill.name: azure-change-digest
skill.description: Read-only daily digest of relevant Azure control-plane changes from Change Analysis in Azure Resource Graph, with platform noise filtered out, who/when/how, old -> new diffs, new role assignments, Activity Log gap events and unusual activity.

agent.name: change-digest-reviewer
agent.handoffDescription: Read-only reviewer of relevant Azure changes (Change Analysis in Azure Resource Graph): daily digest, deletes, exposure and security changes, new role assignments, locks and diagnostic settings, who changed what and unusual activity.

schedule.name: Azure Changes - Daily relevant changes digest
schedule.description: Every day: read-only digest of the relevant Azure changes of the last 24 hours, with noise filtered out, deletes, security-relevant changes, new role assignments, Activity Log gap events and unusual activity.
schedule.agentPrompt: @change-digest-reviewer Run the daily relevant Azure changes digest (operation=report, period=last_24h). Give me the links to the HTML report, the JSON snapshot and the two CSV files first, then the headline, the high and medium changes, deletes, security-relevant changes, new role assignments, Activity Log gap events, unusual activity and the coverage.
